_readme: Which MCP server to use for a registry row. Matched on the exact `entity` string (and optionally the API host).
Env var names were read from each MCP's own source on 2026-11-05. Socrata rows hand off to the `socrata` MCP by domain; that rule lives in code, not here.

servers.note: Calendar, status alerts and service-request lookup. For 311 service-request *data*, use the socrata MCP on data.cityofnewyork.us.
NYS OpenLegislation: bills, laws, calendars, transcripts.

servers.entity: Office of the New York City Comptroller
servers.note: Checkbook NYC spending, contracts, payroll, budget, revenue.
Local build only (BetaNYC/mta-mcp, deliberately unpublished because of MTA's data terms). Service alerts and accessibility outages.

servers.entity: NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services
servers.note: The City Record: notices, procurement, hearings.
